messages:
leah: Morning! Tiny holiday thing: who wants to enter a 'desk luck' swap? Bring one small sun-safe lantern, ugly scarf, or novelty tie. We'll randomize matches and do a reveal next week. :deciduous_tree::sparkles:
tom: Oooo I have a tie my grandma knitted. It's delightfully tragic. Count me in.
ops-bot: Heads-up: Commons table reserved for "Holiday Swap" 3-4pm next Wed. :calendar:
nora: I'm in too. Also quick poll: should we include a 'desk elf' adoption option? I have a felt elf that needs rehoming.
diego: Yes to elf. Also proposing a silly award: "Most Likely to Be Re-gifted at 2pm"
leah: Love it. Rules: small, desk-friendly, under $10 or handmade. Label if fragile. Swap will be anonymous; guesses welcome.
cass: Can I nominate 'best accidental glitter' as a category? Glitter is a renewable resource.
tom: +1 glitter category. Also offering to bring tissue paper and those little sticker name tags.
ops-bot: @facilities FYI: someone requested a small table covering for swap.
nora: Who's bringing hot cider? This needs cider.
diego: I can bring a thermos. Hot chocolate option?
cass: I'll bring a jar of marshmallows. Gluten-free mini bag too.
leah: Perfect. To enter, drop a photo (no faces) here by Tuesday 5pm and add the emoji of your item's vibe: :tada: for festive, :grimacing: for ugly, :sparkles: for handmade. We'll randomize and pair.
tom: Photo posted! (yes it's an ugly tie)
nora: Elf photo incoming. He has a tiny felt scarf.
cass: Marshmallow inventory checked.
leah: Awesome. This is low-key, low-pressure. Winner of 'most likely to re-gift' gets a virtual trophy gif and a dedicated Slack meme.
ops-bot: Reminder: bring own mug if reheating at commons.
diego: Noted. See you all at the reveal.
